All — quick sizing note ahead of the replay: based on peak QPS=400 and 8k token context (median request ~450 tokens), initial recommendation:
- Recommendation: 2 x A100-perf-equipped nodes in a dedicated pool (can sustain steady-state 400 QPS with <150ms per-token internal processing for the selected model).
- Burst handling: enable autoscale + 4x burst capacity (pre-warm additional A10G nodes) to cover 650 QPS spikes for short windows.
- Caching: with 20% prefix cache hit, effective load drops to ~320 QPS equivalent.

I'll prepare a short runbook for failback and throttling settings and attach to the MAP update. Marissa — I can have the sizing doc and cost delta ready by Aug 20.

Jordan — if outbound IPs are OK for us-west-2, we just need a test API key and the sanitized export by Aug 6 to run the dry-run on Aug 9.

Cheers,
